name: 01-setup
title: First launch and model setup
caption: The first interactive launch guides you through provider, model, profile, and hidden credential setup. This session selected a local compatible model.

name: 02-chat
title: Chat with AgentScope
caption: An actual response to “Who are you?” from the configured SmolLM2 model, followed by model status. This small local model demonstrates the connection; answers come from the model you choose.

name: 03-guide
title: Learn the monitoring workflow
caption: The built-in guide explains configuration, launching an application, inspecting records, investigating incidents, and stopping monitoring.

name: 04-watch
title: Start monitoring and run an application
caption: Watch starts the local API and dashboard. Run launches the sample application with capture enabled and records a genuine local LLM call.

name: 05-activity
title: Inspect model usage, failures, and runs
caption: The sample recorded two LLM calls: one success and one deliberately missing model. Status reports 60 tokens and one failure; runs and agents show the underlying records. Unsupported claims remain Not evaluated.

name: 06-models-context
title: Manage the assistant and project context
caption: View available providers and saved profiles, opt into sharing project summary metrics, turn context off, and clear the conversation.

name: 07-investigation
title: Detect and investigate an incident
caption: Synthetic tool-loop telemetry triggers real incident detection and a persisted investigation with eight evidence references. These are practice records, not a production incident.

name: 08-recovery
title: Approve, execute, and verify demo recovery
caption: Synthetic demo only: enable demo control, approve a proposal, execute it separately, and verify recovery against recorded follow-up activity. Real-agent recommendations remain advisory.

name: 09-commands
title: Complete REPL command reference
caption: The complete command reference covers chat, monitoring, projects, runs, incidents, investigations, demo controls, and session management.

name: 10-shutdown
title: Stop safely and keep recorded telemetry
caption: Stop ends the owned watch services; exit closes the REPL. Recorded telemetry is kept for a later session.
